models_evaluated: reasoning-enhanced variants of Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-32B and Gemini-2.5-Flash

links.outcome: Model accuracy under unpublished bias-inducing prompt variations versus published prompts
links.effect: Gemini-2.5-Flash accuracy dropped from 80.0-88.6% to 47.4-86.1% with four unpublished bias-inducing prompts, exposing brittleness.
links.quote: The performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash dropped considerably when exposing it to four additional unpublished bias-inducing prompts (from 80.0-88.6% to 47.4-86.1%), hinting at potential contamination of its training data and exposing underlying brittleness.

links.outcome: Gap between public benchmark performance and performance on unpublished prompts (possible contamination)
links.effect: Gemini-2.5-Flash fell from 80.0-88.6% on public BiasMedQA prompts to 47.4-86.1% on unpublished prompts, hinting at training data contamination.
links.quote: The performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash dropped considerably when exposing it to four additional unpublished bias-inducing prompts (from 80.0-88.6% to 47.4-86.1%), hinting at potential contamination of its training data and exposing underlying brittleness.

unlisted_practices: Debiasing prompt instructing the LLM to actively mitigate cognitive bias
Few-shot prompting with sample cases of biased responses to reduce biased responses
Reasoning-enhanced LLM variants to reduce susceptibility to cognitive bias-inducing prompts

screen.practice: debiasing prompt and few-shot prompt guardrails
screen.reason: Empirically tests prompt-based debiasing safeguards (debiasing instructions and few-shot examples) to mitigate cognitive biases in LLMs on clinical QA benchmarks.
